component.name: rigcheck
component.summary: Check which Steam games your PC can run on Linux

description.p: rigcheck compares your hardware with the system requirements of every Steam game and tells you, game by game, whether your Linux PC can run it: ready, at low settings, too weak or blocked.
It also shows what matters on Linux:

ul.li: ProtonDB ratings and native Linux builds
Anti-cheat that blocks Linux, from AreWeAntiCheatYet
Which part of your PC holds a game back

description.p: Local-first: the game database is downloaded once and updated in the background. No accounts, no telemetry; the app only talks to GitHub (the database) and Steam (games and cover art).

screenshot.caption: Your Steam library with a verdict for every game
A game's requirements next to your PC

description.p: Library: ALL MY GAMES, with your own Steam Web API key. Catalog: a grid of cover tiles. Looked-up games show their verdict on every page.
First packaged release: Library, Catalog of every Steam game, live lookups, background database updates.
